summary: D-04 now uses a dedicated essay writing workspace. The page shows a writing command header, step flow, prompt and condition support column, essay manuscript composer, autosave and submit controls, live manuscript preview, and a visible six-item essay checklist.
acceptedVariance: The active q54 draft contract stores a single essay text plus checklist status in answer_json. Editing therefore remains in a textarea while the manuscript grid is a live preview.
The hifi includes decorative tutor imagery and secondary tools that are not required by description.md and are not added as net-new behavior in this audit.
Next dev indicator may appear in local screenshots. It is not product UI and is excluded from visual severity.

findings.claim: Resolved: D-04 now renders a question-54-specific essay workspace instead of the generic stacked long-form editor.
findings.observed: The route shows a command header, stepper, source column, composer column, and checklist column at the audited desktop width; mobile stacks the same sections in a readable order.
findings.expected: Essay writing 54 should keep problem conditions, long essay composition, and checklist state visible as a dedicated workspace.

findings.claim: Resolved: topic, background, required questions, rubric conditions, and reference material stay in the support column.
findings.observed: The left column renders QuestionPrompt, ConditionsPanel, ReferenceMaterials, and a concise guide. The editor and submit actions lock when submitBlockedReason is present.
findings.expected: D-04 should show the essay topic, required conditions, and rubric summary; submission should be blocked when required problem data is incomplete.

findings.claim: Resolved: the composer exposes essay length, paragraph state, autosave, manual save, and submit gating.
findings.observed: The composer includes 600-700 recommended range copy, progress bar, paragraph count, autosave toggle, manual save, blur validation, and a submit confirmation path.
findings.expected: The editor should support 600-700 recommended characters, a 300-character minimum, paragraph state, save/submit controls, and insufficient-length feedback.

findings.claim: Resolved: the six-item essay checklist remains visible next to the composer on desktop.
findings.observed: The route renders the existing EssayChecklist with intro, body, conclusion, evidence, connector, and topic-fit checks using unchecked, partial, and complete states.
findings.expected: D-04 should provide no more than six checklist items covering structure, evidence, connectors, and prompt fit.

findings.claim: Resolved: the page renders stably across audited breakpoints.
findings.observed: The render-shot manifest records status=200, errorOverlay=false, and consoleErrorCount=0 for 360, 768, and 1280 widths. The targeted e2e screen test also passed across the same projects.
findings.expected: The route should render without runtime page errors or incoherent overlap on mobile, tablet, and desktop.
